SELECT b.id AS menu_id, b.number AS menu_number, b.name, b.icon, c.number AS app_number, c.name AS app_name, b.component, b.target_type, b.external_url, b.external_open_mode FROM t_sys_user_home_quick_launch a INNER JOIN t_sys_menu b ON b.id = a.menu_id INNER JOIN t_sys_app c ON c.id = b.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain d ON d.id = c.domain_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.scope_type = #{scope} AND b.enabled = true AND c.enabled = true AND d.enabled = true
AND a.app_id = #{appId} AND b.app_id = #{appId}
AND a.app_id IS NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_sys_role_perms e INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role f ON f.role_id = e.role_id WHERE e.permission_id = b.permission_id AND f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.org_id = #{orgId} )
ORDER BY a.seq, a.id
SELECT a.id FROM t_sys_user a WHERE a.id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
